home.title: Sabiha Bakery
home.description: Order fresh bread, pastries and cakes from Sabiha Bakery for pickup. Pay in person when you collect.

login.title: Kitchen login
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage orders and the menu.

rejected.title: This account isn’t approved
rejected.body: {email} isn’t set up for this bakery. Ask the owner to add it in Settings.

login.network: Couldn’t reach Google. Check your connection and try again.
login.failed: Something went wrong while signing you in. Wait a minute and try again.
login.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue — you’ll go back to {destination}.
login.approvedOnly: Only approved bakery accounts can sign in.

keep.label: Keep me signed in on this device
keep.hint: Leave this on for the kitchen tablet. Turn it off on a shared or personal device.

help.title: Trouble signing in?
steps: Make sure you’re using the bakery’s Google account, not a personal one.
If you’ve never signed in before, the owner needs to add your email in Settings first.
help.call: Still stuck? Call the owner on {phone}.

telegram.test: Test message from {bakery}. New orders will be announced here.
